name: ri_microsoft_semicolon_editing
note: Steps 18-20 are not the reference's output. Step 18 listed [你, 拟] four times in the reference: the reference appended every shorter shuangpin prefix group whole (shuangpin/shuangpin_dictionary.cpp:214-229) and, for a single trailing helpcode, appended the whole-input series and then the unmatched rows after the matched ones (SD:370-372), so a word several of those lists answer was listed once per list. Showing the same candidate more than once is a bug (decision 2026-09-30): the port keeps each word at its first seat and drops the later copies, and step 18 was rewritten to [你, 拟]. Steps 19-20 (MoveLeft) hold the Rust caret-prefix decode. In the reference, MoveLeft only stores the caret and returns without recomputing (core/input_session_editing.cpp:132-134 and :157-158), because the caret_prefix overlay failed to apply to the recorded build (.migration/spec/overlays.md §7.6), so it kept showing the step-18 list. The port decodes only the complete units before the caret (decisions.md: caret_prefix follows upstream bc46f27), so caret 5 decodes ni'nn and caret 4 decodes ni', each answering [你, 拟]; steps 19-20 were rewritten to that output.
